field_text_formatted.value: 4.1.0 is, deliberately, a bit of a nostalgia trip. A handful of the things that made the module worth reaching for in the first place quietly went missing during the Drupal 8 port (formatter settings, live preview, a real code editor, Devel Generate support), and this release brings four of them back. There's new stuff too.
